claim_ceiling: Three complementary dense embedding modes validated at maximum available evaluated scale (24yr/158k for citation heritage, 1K sample for cross-lingual, 22yr/144k for linear hybrids). All validated against evaluation lane criteria. Data blockers prevent 174k completion. Lane correctly BLOCKED_ON_DEPENDENCIES. No representation achieves factory jurist preference target (0.7) under true OOS conditions.
evidence_summary: Verified: 24yr citation heritage (158k decisions, 730 pairs, CP AUC 0.767-0.770); 22yr weight sweep (144k, 9 weights, exact k-NN); section cross-lingual (1K sample, 3 sections × 3 reps); legal TF-IDF BGE (8 variants × 14 benchmarks); v18 coarse hierarchy (6 reps, max purity 0.65 < 0.7). Negative results preserved: dense FAILS jurist gate all scales; TF-IDF BGE FAILS 8/14; true OOS JP ceiling ~0.53; Erwaegungen cross-lingual FAILS; raw 768 FAILS citation heritage; linear hybrids below TF-IDF baseline. Blockers: BGE/bger ID mapping, parquet 2024-2026 (15.5k), section extraction 174k, quality check false negative on 2022-2023 embeddings. One narrative imprecision: TF-IDF citation-based AUC 0.71-0.74 claimed 'PASS' but legal_tfidf_bge shows 0.5 (cross-corpus difference). Does not invalidate core findings.
